item.title: Array Labs radar gains $10m Mitsubishi Electric backing
item.summary: Mitsubishi Electric has invested US$10 million in Array Labs, taking a leading role in a US$21 million strategic funding round aimed at expanding satellite-based radar services for defence and security customers in the Asia-Pacific region.
